name: Smart Router
description: Acts as a smart router that identifies user intent and activates the appropriate task-specific agent, ensuring accurate and efficient handling of proposal creation, sales FAQs, meeting preparation, briefing notes, content review, and pitch decks.

conversation_starters.title: Generate a proposal
conversation_starters.text: Create a proposal for Contoso covering a 12-week data platform migration, and return it as a Word document.

conversation_starters.title: Ask a sales question
conversation_starters.text: What is our discount approval process for deals above $250,000?

conversation_starters.title: Prepare for a client meeting
conversation_starters.text: I have a meeting with the Contoso account team next week. Summarise the client, recent interactions, and key talking points.

conversation_starters.title: Format a briefing note
conversation_starters.text: Format these meeting notes into our standard meeting brief template.

conversation_starters.title: Review content quality
conversation_starters.text: Review this proposal draft for clarity, structure, tone, and consistency, and list the changes you recommend.

conversation_starters.title: Build a pitch deck
conversation_starters.text: Turn our existing case studies and service descriptions into a proactive pitch deck for a retail client.
